content: No conclusive source found on whether WKWebView swallows Cmd+K in a Wails v2 macOS app. Generic reports exist of some shortcuts being intercepted (e.g. Wails GitHub issue #2582, Cmd+Ctrl+F); no app-level Menu/accelerator is registered in this repo's main.go, so the palette's own DOM keydown listener is the only capture mechanism -- flagged for first-task manual verification.
